messages:
Evan T: Raised a follow-up to the postmortem — appears this is a recurring pattern: delayed ingest spikes every ~6 weeks causing token undercounts. Need a remediation cadence and owners for invoice fixes. PM: https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-recurring-ingest-pattern
Maya R: Noted. I ran a quick query and found three distinct incidents in the last 5 months with similar failure signatures (rebalance + lag). I'll attach the incident list to the JIRA.
Devin K: I can take the engineering remediation (consumer resiliency + backfill automation). Goal: implement idempotent reingest job + a canary run for late events. Estimate: patch + staging dry-run in 5 business days.
Clara G: I'll own billing corrections and customer comms. Need standardized CSV: account_id, period_start, period_end, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, credit_usd. Also a template for small vs large credits.
Evan T: Can we get concrete dates? Devin, when is earliest CSV for billing to act on?
Devin K: If patch lands and dry-run succeeds, I can produce the full deltas CSV in 3 days after the prod backfill. Conservative ETA: 2026-03-29. Risk: late-arrivers in archival shards could push it a day.
Maya R: I'll add monitoring rules: 1) consumer-lag alert (threshold: >1000 late events / 5m) 2) weekly ingestion-lag sweep for 8 weeks after fix. PR to monitoring by 2026-03-25.
billing-bot: JIRA-4800 created: "Recurring delayed ingest pattern - remediation plan". Labels: billing, monitoring, recurring. Priority: P2.
Clara G: Accounting: please advise any thresholds for manual review of credits (e.g., >$250 require manager signoff). Evan, is that ok?
Evan T: Yes, set $250 manual review threshold. Also add legal review for high-value refunds.
Devin K: For traceability I'll include a validation log with sample diffs (top 25 accounts) and checksum of the CSV. Will attach to JIRA-4800.
Maya R: I'll also add a short runbook section for this failure mode with the SQL snippet and validation steps. Draft by 2026-03-27.
Clara G: Scheduling a comms review on 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Invite accounting and customer success.
Evan T: Summarizing owners and dates:
- Engineering patch + backfill + deltas CSV -> Devin K -> due 2026-03-29
- Monitoring PR + weekly sweep schedule -> Maya R -> PR by 2026-03-25
- Invoice corrections + comms + credit processing -> Clara G -> send by 2026-04-01 after accounting sign-off
- Accounting sign-off policy + thresholds -> Evan T -> provide guidance by 2026-03-28
Devin K: Starting the staging canary today for a small shard. Will post results to JIRA-4800 when done.
Maya R: Opening monitoring PR now.
Clara G: Thanks team. I'll wait for the CSV before crafting emails.
